column3: NASB follows the critical text (“and by”) without “therefore I” and “Lord”; “earnestly declare” is rendered “solemnly charge you.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB renders “convict” as “reprove” and “complete patience” as “great patience.”
NASB renders “having an itching ear” as “wanting to have their ears tickled” and “gather around” as “accumulate.”
NASB renders “the hearing” as “their ears.”
NASB renders “afflictions” as “hardship” and “fully carry out” as “fulfill.”
NASB adds “as a drink offering.”
NASB follows the critical text; “race” is rendered “course.”
NASB renders “from now on” as “in the future” and “those loving” as “all who have loved,” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “be diligent” as “Make every effort.”
NASB renders “age” as “world” and adds “has gone.”
NASB renders “having taken Mark” as “Pick up Mark” and “ministry” as “service.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB reorders the verse.
NASB follows the critical text (future “will repay”); the Textus Receptus has a wish.
NASB follows the critical text (“opposed”); “message” is rendered “teaching.”
NASB follows the critical text (“supported”); “be charged” is rendered “be counted.”
NASB follows the critical text (“might hear”); “stood by” is rendered “stood with.”
NASB follows the critical text without “and”; “to the ages of the ages” is rendered “forever and ever.”
NASB renders “house” as “household.”
NASB renders “ailing” as “sick.”
NASB renders “be eager” as “Make every effort.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Jesus Christ,” “Amen,” and the Textus Receptus subscription.
